_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for fleet image-gen remediations. Consumed by the hugpy-agent (loads this via importlib.resources) AND rendered by the console Docs 'Fleet remediation runbook' page. Each entry: a failure SIGNATURE the agent can match in an error/heartbeat, a DETECT check, and a REMEDY it can execute via the worker /ops endpoints (evict, pip, restart, free-ram, config) or a shell action. Keep edits HERE only.

remediations.signature: LoadRefusal: won't fit on GPU; POLITE LOAD (no_evict): N evictable idle resident(s) were SPARED
remediations.cause: A big model (e.g. 17GB FLUX) can't load because idle image models hold VRAM and the polite/no_evict load won't reclaim them.
remediations.detect: nvidia-smi free VRAM < needed; worker pid_registry has image-model residents (vram_bytes>1GB, host_mode not comfy/cuda_context, key not gguf/llama/qwen).
remediations.remedy: Evict each idle image resident via /ops/evict {force:true}. Keep llama-server (gguf) + ComfyUI. Evicted models reload on next call.
remediations.automated_by: ae: systemd --user timer vram-reaper.timer runs /home/solcatcher/bashScripts/vram-reaper.sh every 3min (VRAM_FREE_MIN_MIB=18000).

remediations.signature: CheckpointLoaderSimple ... json.decoder.JSONDecodeError: Expecting value: line 1 column 1 (char 0)
remediations.cause: The .safetensors file is a truncated/incomplete download: its 8-byte header length is 0, so the safetensors JSON header is empty.
remediations.detect: struct '<Q' first 8 bytes == 0 (or > filesize). Note: on this fleet the misc/comfy/<key>/ copies are often corrupt while /mnt/16T_toshiba/llm_storage/checkpoints/<canonical> is VALID.
remediations.remedy: Replace the corrupt file with a valid copy. Canonical valid copies live on the central store at /mnt/16T_toshiba/llm_storage/checkpoints/<canonical-name>. scp to the worker's ComfyUI models/checkpoints farm, or re-assign the model to trigger ensure_comfy_checkpoint download.

remediations.cause: The worker's ComfyUI does not expose a checkpoint under the exact canonical name central sends. New workers have no extra_model_paths.yaml, or the farm used local (non-canonical) names.
remediations.detect: GET http://<worker>:8188/object_info/CheckpointLoaderSimple ckpt_name list lacks the requested name.
remediations.remedy: Build a FLAT symlink farm at <store>/ComfyUI/models/checkpoints where every checkpoint is symlinked under its CANONICAL name (match ae's /object_info list). Point extra_model_paths.yaml checkpoints at that farm. Restart comfyui.service. For models the worker lacks, assign them (triggers ensure_comfy_checkpoint pull from central).

remediations.signature: comfy model rows must set `filename` to the checkpoint name inside ComfyUI's models/checkpoints
remediations.cause: get_model_config(key).filename is None — the comfy model row / manifest has no filename, so the runner can't name the checkpoint. Often duplicate bare rows (e.g. dreamshaper-8, dreamshaper-8-pruned) created by a discover-models sweep.
remediations.detect: get_model_config(model_key).filename in (None, ''). Multiple registry rows share a name with filename None.
remediations.remedy: Set the row's filename to the canonical checkpoint name in the model's hugpy.json manifest (and dedupe stale rows), OR assign the model so provisioning re-derives it. The comfy_runner reads cfg.filename.

remediations.signature: ImportError: Using `bitsandbytes` ... requires bitsandbytes  |  cannot run task '<task>' (missing optional dependency)  |  llama-cpp-python is installed WITHOUT GPU offload support
remediations.cause: The worker's python lacks an optional dep: bitsandbytes (4-bit quant), diffusers/accelerate/transformers (imagegen / text-to-image capability), CUDA llama-cpp-python (GGUF GPU offload).
remediations.detect: task_capabilities[task]==False, or an ImportError at serve time. task_deps: text-to-image->diffusers[imagegen], image-text-to-text->llama_cpp[engine].
remediations.remedy: Install into the WORKER's python via /ops/pip. Common: 'bitsandbytes>=0.46.1'; 'diffusers accelerate transformers>=4.50.3 safetensors' (imagegen); rebuild CUDA llama-cpp-python with CMAKE_ARGS=-DGGML_CUDA=on (needs gcc<=12 vs nvcc). Restart the worker to re-advertise capability.

remediations.signature: local model serving is disabled on this box (HUGPY_NO_LOCAL_SERVING) ... no registered worker is available to serve
remediations.cause: A model is assigned to an incapable/offline worker (e.g. computron lacked the image dep) and the serving box refuses to fall back.
remediations.detect: Error names HUGPY_NO_LOCAL_SERVING or 'assigned but no worker could serve'.
remediations.remedy: On the capable GPU worker set Environment=HUGPY_LOCAL_FALLBACK=always (drop-in) so it serves any routed model, then restart. Also repair/assign the model to a healthy worker.

remediations.signature: '<model>' failed to become ready on '<small-worker>' after 90s with no forward progress
remediations.cause: central routed a model larger than the worker's GPU (e.g. FLUX to an 8GB card), which stalls then fails.
remediations.detect: worker vram_total small (<10GB) and a big model routed to it.
remediations.remedy: Cap the small worker's routable VRAM budget: Environment=HUGPY_GPU_MEM_GIB=<cardGB-1> (e.g. 7 for an 8GB 4060). Restart. central then won't assign models that don't fit.

remediations.signature: Generations come out as framed paintings / gallery walls (visual, not an error).
remediations.cause: guidance/CFG too low for the model: at CFG 0 (sd-turbo default) the negative prompt has NO effect, so the standard anti-frame negative is ignored; SD1.5/SDXL also need ~25 steps.
remediations.detect: Model is SD1.5/SDXL but request guidance ~0 and/or steps ~4.
remediations.remedy: Use CFG ~7 + ~25 steps for SD1.5/SDXL (composer default now). Turbo/lightning models are the exception: CFG ~1, steps ~4. Ensure the standard negative (frame, picture frame, ornate frame, border, framed painting, gallery wall, watermark, signature, text) is composed in.

remediations.signature: CLIPTextEncode ... clip input is invalid: None ... checkpoint does not contain a valid clip or text encoder
remediations.cause: The checkpoint is a UNET/diffusion-component only (no CLIP baked in, e.g. some FLUX/component models). The vanilla t2i graph (CheckpointLoaderSimple->CLIPTextEncode) can't drive it.
remediations.detect: Model framework=comfy but the checkpoint lacks a CLIP; error at the CLIPTextEncode node.
remediations.remedy: Use a component workflow that loads unet/clip/vae separately (UNETLoader + DualCLIPLoader + VAELoader) with the model's comfy-kinds components. Register that (framework, task) runner/builder pair. This is per-model workflow work, not an auto-fix.

remediations.signature: Bringing a new GPU box online as an image worker (comfy_available False / t2i False).
remediations.cause: Fresh worker has no ComfyUI and/or no imagegen deps.
remediations.detect: worker comfy.available False or task_capabilities.text-to-image False.
remediations.remedy: 1) Install vanilla comfyanonymous/ComfyUI + torch (matching cuXXX) + ComfyUI-Manager (venv via get-pip if no python3-venv). 2) systemd --user comfyui.service on 127.0.0.1:8188 (--listen 0.0.0.0 if it must be proxied). 3) extra_model_paths.yaml + a canonical flat checkpoint farm. 4) /ops/pip diffusers+accelerate+transformers. 5) restart worker -> it adopts comfy + advertises t2i. 6) optional: nginx vhost (e.g. comfy2.hugpy.ai) + certbot --nginx. 7) HUGPY_GPU_MEM_GIB cap for a small card.
